name: 宽扣厚底玛丽珍
materials: 哑黑皮面 · 烟银方扣 · 黑色胶底
statement: 宽带横过脚背，圆钝鞋头与厚底形成紧凑体积。
brand: 带端小型双片金属徽记，侧腰低对比压字。
difference: 与 F01 的细斜带、杏仁头、低平底区分：宽横带、圆钝头、厚平台。
spec: Preserve the reference broad single-strap Mary Jane silhouette: round-to-blunt generous toe, low scooped instep opening, closed heel, single WIDE strap and substantial continuous black flatform. Not a pointy office flat. Matte black softly grained leather upper; strap is black leather-faced webbing with ONE simple gunmetal rectangular buckle and one row of discrete holes (not original double eyelets). Add an EXACT small silver two-panel emblem as a flat flush stud at the strap END beyond buckle, not part of buckle mechanism. A subtle small MOVERNO deboss on outer rear quarter. Change original heavily vertical-ribbed sole to BLACK continuous platform with two shallow horizontal channels and a short band of fine diagonal microtexture at toe; no waffle pattern. Keep full platform thickness and compact round toe. No lace, chains dangling, bows, studs elsewhere or full pattern print. Black rubber wraps only low edge of toe, not an oversized white cap.

name: 链纹厚底一脚蹬
materials: 黑色织面 · 石墨提花 · 骨白底墙
statement: 连续鞋面不设鞋眼，深浅织纹在脚背交汇。
brand: 链纹仅进入前鞋面，后跟留小字标与徽记。
difference: 与 R06 的胶包头、系带和全侧织纹区分：无系带、无外加胶头、前片局部提花。
spec: Preserve Input1's clearly laceless skate slip-on shape with long continuous rounded vamp, closed low padded collar, two tiny elastic gussets beside instep and a thick BONE platform foxing. No external rubber toe cap extending over vamp, NO laces, no tongue patch. Front vamp is dense black/graphite JACQUARD with a regular medium-small repeat of input4's linked curved-panel pattern, TONAL charcoal-on-black with one restrained dull-silver outline thread; rear quarters plain matte black cotton twill. Source checkerboard/stripes entirely removed. Exact small MOVERNO serif wordmark on a sewn plain BLACK heel tab and a tiny black double-panel emblem debossed at outer rear sole only. Fine bone piping at vamp/sole seam, plain pale inner collar, thick bone sidewall has a slim black lower line and light pebbled rubber texture, original short linear tread. Do not add giant letters across sole, do not turn into loafers with a penny strap, no moccasin apron seam.

name: 错阶宽带运动凉鞋
materials: 骨白基底 · 石墨织带 · 低光橡胶
statement: 露趾与侧面留空，让宽带成为鞋身结构。
brand: 脚背带端双片徽记，后带局部同色链纹。
difference: 与后空闭趾 R02、已有闭头 sandal 方向区分：前掌完全露趾、开侧面、独立后带和厚平台。
spec: Use Input1's OPEN-TOE athletic sandal silhouette and thick flatform volume. Keep visible toe footbed, a wide forefoot strap, separate diagonal instep strap and narrow heel strap, large clean side openings; no closed toe roof and no toe posts. Change to a BONE matte moulded base and GRAPHITE black woven straps, with black padded backing touching foot. The forefoot strap starts lower and the instep strap higher, deliberate stepped placement. Single low-profile hook-and-loop closures, no metal buckles. Exact small BONE MOVERNO two-panel emblem on the instep strap END, no other brand. Heel strap uses a very subtle charcoal-on-black linked-panel jacquard from Input4. Small MOVERNO serif deboss on the outer rear BONE midsole and heel footbed. Continuous bone platform with shallow waist, simple original short offset rectangular tread, no excessive protruding back heel or orthopedic arch machinery. Full matching pair, foreground outer3/4 and visible empty footbeds. Show coherent straps attached at real anchors, not floating ribbons.

name: 厚底绒面切尔西靴
materials: 烟灰褐绒面 · 深棕弹力片 · 咖黑厚底
statement: 深色弹力侧片收住短筒，下方保留整块厚底。
brand: 前后提环用短字标，外后侧嵌同色徽记。
difference: 与 R03 极短筒、薄底及裸露绒口区分：更高短筒、弹力开合、明显平台底；不采用 N06 充棉系带。
spec: Preserve the source's suede PLATFORM CHELSEA ankle boot, compact full rounded toe, continuous rounded falling vamp, tall U-shaped elastic side panels and substantial flat platform. Not a slim dress Chelsea, no separate block heel. Color is smoky MUSHROOM/TAUPE suede, dark ESPRESSO elastic gore and COFFEE-BLACK thick rubber sole. Just a trace of dark short-pile lining INSIDE opening, no fur turned over cuff. Short front and back narrow pull loops are plain taupe webbing with tiny dark MOVERNO wordmarks; reduce their length compared to reference. Standard double-panel emblem as a small flush espresso suede inset on outer rear quarter below gore, with exact geometry and neat stitching. No repeat on elastic gore because stretching would distort pattern. Sole has one broad shallow tonal groove separating upper/lower layers, simple short diagonal tread not original sole tooling. Pair low3/4 foreground and complementary rear angle behind so one heel tab visible. No laces, no buckle, no quilting, no zipper, no random hardware.

name: 宽扁带绒面运动鞋
category: 厚舌中低帮 / 宽带系合
materials: 焦糖绒面 · 浅褐网眼 · 咖棕胶底
statement: 宽扁鞋带压住厚舌，网眼从绒面边缘露出。
brand: 侧后方与鞋带端分配双片徽记，鞋舌落标准字标。
difference: 与 R05 低口、粗圆绳、银色雕塑底区分：中低鞋口、宽扁织带、平缓整体胶底和绒面网眼。
spec: Preserve Input1's full suede-and-mesh Lowmel-style mid-low chunky street shoe volume, moderately raised padded collar, thick NORMAL UPRIGHT tongue (DO NOT FOLD TONGUE OVER), wide flat patterned shoe laces and flat thick tonal gum-like outsole. Warm TOASTED CARAMEL suede panels, light taupe open ballistic-look mesh at vamp and rear quarters, creamy small collar lining, COCOA brown outsole. Use a short set of very WIDE FLAT cream/taupe woven laces crossing only 3 times, tucked ends, no giant round rope, no ankle wrap or bow. Fine MOVERNO repeating double-panel motif only at the two visible flat LACE ENDS, not original zigzag/checkered laces. Replace UGG logo with one small dark cocoa exact two-panel suede applique on outer rear quarter and small MOVERNO wordmark on the un-folded tongue top. Original gentle curved suede panel boundaries, one clean saddle curve, no sports side stripe. Sole is solid flat quietly rounded brown sidewall with no oval pods, no huge extensions. Keep original relaxed substantial sneaker shape, not formal shoes or hiking boots.

name: 软筒包头运动靴
materials: 黑色微蜡织物 · 骨白包头 · 奶白橡胶底
statement: 软筒在脚踝自然起褶，胶包头保留运动感。
brand: 筒后窄幅链纹织带，后跟底小型品牌字标。
difference: 由官图大腿高筒转为小腿中筒；与 R04 的直立系带、斜拉链和巨厚底区分：软筒套入、无系带、适中底。
spec: Input1 is a thigh-high sock-sneaker boot. Translate it into a CALF-MIDHEIGHT soft pull-on sneaker boot, about halfway between ankle and knee, NOT thigh-high. Preserve the soft black stretch-denim surface, natural draping at ankle, rounded BONE sneaker toe cap and continuous BONE rubber sole. Full pair of empty boots in studio (NO LEGS OR PEOPLE from reference). Both shafts lightly structured by invisible product support, enough small natural folds around ankle to show softness; NOT folded over cuffs, no slouch collapsing onto ground. Medium thick bone sole, substantially LOWER than a huge mega platform, no separate high heel. Simple flat fine linear bottom tread instead of Rick shark teeth. Add one narrow low-contrast BLACK/CHARCOAL linked-panel jacquard ribbon vertically along BACK outer seam up the calf, integrated as textile facing not a dangling strap. Small MOVERNO serif wordmark on rear sole block, tiny black standard emblem at top OUTER cuff. Plain central shaft and vamp, no laces, no visible zipper, no metal hardware, no giant text. Smooth low domed bone toe follows foot, no long or square clown cap. Compose whole PAIR full-height diagonally in landscape3:2 with adequate margin, still sharp product photo.
